text:
mila: quick signal: after the IAM conditional changed last night, we're seeing KMS grant expiries + exporter retries in eu-west -> privatelink conntrack pressure. GPU warm-pool nodes failing to finish onboarding.

sec-bot: [ALERT] kms-grant-expiry euw: grant-retries x420 in 15m; privatelink conntrack_slab_high. trigger=warm-pool-onboard-failures.

rahul: paste from node-a12: 
```
2026-04-02T02:11:05 kubelet: warmup pod failed: keystore GET timeout
kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
keystore-exporter euw org=svc latency=1300ms status=504
```

zoe: sounds like two cascaded things: IAM conditional tweak caused STS/KMS transient denials -> exporter retry storm -> conntrack. Short fixes: 1) short STS permit rollback for keystore service, 2) throttle exporter, 3) bump conntrack_max on privatelink NATs.

mila: Compliance wants audit logs retained 180d; security prefers no rollbacks. Can we do a scoped STS allowlist for keystore nodes only while we throttle exporter?

rahul: cost quicknote: moving retention to 180d + retry amplification = est +$9k/mo euw. Scoped rollback costs org buy-in but lowers ops blast.

zoe: proposed mitigation: A) add temporary IAM conditional exception for service-account:keystore-exporter for 2h, B) push token-bucket throttle to exporter ingress (200rps burst 400), C) sysctl bump net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max + monitor.

mila: I'll open COMPL ticket with justification and re-audit plan. also pinging @security-approvers for emergency exception.

sec-bot: [REQ] emergency exception requested: COMPL-7788. please attach logs, cost delta, and rollback window.

ops-bot: [INFO] applied conntrack_max bump on nat-euw. prev_count=188900 new_max=300000. monitoring metrics.

rahul: throttle canary to 10% exporter replicas now. will scale if stable.

zoe: testing STS allowlist on a single signer pod. if that clears retries we can avoid broader rollback.

mila: security responded: prefer STS allowlist + throttle over retention rollback. approving 2h exception for keystore-exporter only, must re-audit and restore policy after.

ops-bot: [METRIC] 12m after changes: exporter 504s down 70%, conntrack_count stabilized, warm-pool join success 24% -> 86%.

rahul: action items: (mila) document exception & cost delta, (zoe) schedule exporter rate-limiting and batching PoC, (ops) add conntrack checklist for big auth changes.

mila: noted. region fallback plan: if euw stays noisy route new GPU allocations to ap-south for 24h. not ideal but lowers blast radius.

sec-bot: [RESOLVE] emergency exception recorded. must attach re-audit results to COMPL-7788 within 48h.

zoe: will follow up with PR for exporter batching (2w ETA) and a runbook entry for IAM change rollouts. closing this quick-thread unless regressions.
